description: AGSC-09-13 (the bound): a `search` answer carries at most 100 hits, and an `ask` answer cites at most 100 item IRIs. The fixture has 120 items `w-001` … `w-120` whose description holds the token `widget`, and three items whose description holds the token `gadget`. `widget` matches 120 items with one point each, so the order is by slug in code-point order: the answer carries `w-001` … `w-100` (`first_slug`, `last_slug`, `hit_count` 100) and `total` 120. `gadget` matches 3 items: the answer carries all three and no `total` member, so an answer under the bound has the bytes of 1.0 and `cli-0007` and `cli-0008` stay valid. The `ask` of `widget` cites between 1 and 100 IRIs. Both transports return the same value (AGSC-09-16): `transports_equal` asks the page tools to agree with the local server on all three calls.
